event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit
event.distribution_pattern: Firm packs products in crates per retail location orders. Kroger arranges a third party to pick up crates at Taylor Farms and deliver to retail locations in IL, IN, KY, MO, OH.

products.product_description: Taylor Farms - Thai Noodle Salad Kit packaged in 108oz plastic bag *Product packages all salad ingredients separate then ships to retail location. Deli counter at retail location mix ingredients and sale as per order servings.
products.reason_for_recall: Downstream Recall - Foreign Material (Plexiglass) found in ingredient used.
